comment: Pinned ClamAV engine releases that ClamMac knows how to install.
ClamMac does not redistribute ClamAV. It downloads the official installer
package published by the ClamAV project and verifies it against the
sha256 recorded here before unpacking a single byte of it.
To add a release: download the .pkg, run `shasum -a 256` on it, and add
an entry. scripts/verify-manifest.py checks every entry in this file.
